channel.title: Business Insider France - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider France (businessinsider.fr)

item.title: Palantir's Florida move is more than just a change of address
item.description: Even if a company doesn't cite a reason for relocating, experts say the change can signal financial, political, or other motives.

item.title: A leaked Pentagon list flagging dozens of universities as risks blindsided schools and military students alike
item.description: Military students face uncertainty as the Pentagon evaluates universities beyond Harvard, potentially affecting top-leveleducation plans.

item.title: Zuckerberg's courthouse entourage showed up in Meta Ray-Bans
item.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg testified in Los Angeles about social media's impact on youth. The judge cracked down on smart glasses in court.

item.title: Nvidia pushes into Intel and AMD's turf with a 'multigenerational' Meta deal
item.description: Meta is deepening its ties to Nvidia in a move that could further pressure Intel and AMD, even as AI demand remains strong.

item.title: DoorDash's CEO says he's got an edge on Amazon in groceries
item.description: DoorDash offers more choice than Amazon by working with a wider range of grocery chains, CEO Tony Xu said during the company's Q4 earnings call.

item.title: FCC Chair Brendan Carr calls Stephen Colbert's censorship concerns 'fake news'
item.description: FCC Chair Brendan Carr addressed Stephen Colbert's claims that CBS pulled a Democratic lawmaker's interview over federal regulatory concerns.

item.title: Parents hope the 'tide will turn' against Big Tech as Mark Zuckerberg takes the stand
item.description: Meta CEO Mark Zuckerberg testified in a landmark trial about social media addiction. Parents who attended hope the 'tide will turn' against Big Tech.

item.title: A JetBlue plane made an emergency landing at Newark after smoke was reported in the cabin
item.description: The airline reported an engine issue and smoke in the cabin of the Airbus A320 plane.

item.title: Drunken boxing and backflips: China put on a robot kung fu display that shows how fast its robotics industry is growing
item.description: China's humanoid robots performed kung fu on national TV, stunning viewers with how quickly the technology has advanced.

item.title: Sarah McLachlan, 58, says she had to 'eat a lot of humble pie' to repair her relationship with her older daughter
item.description: Sarah McLachlan said family counseling made her realize her communication methods made her daughter feel worse about herself.
